states: Paired production dist builds of base a453fe365f and patched AlertDeliveryPausedCard, AlertDestinationsLoadErrorCard, and AlertNoDestinationsCard served over loopback HTTP via pulse-worker-browser in desktop Chromium (1440x940 light) and touch phone WebKit (360x820 dark, isMobile=true, hasTouch=true) with 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 unexpected HTTP>=400 responses, and 0px horizontal overflow across all 12 captures (all 12 PNGs inspected via native image reading).

/alerts paused delivery state (AlertDeliveryPausedCard): desktop preserves compact 20px/34px layout; phone touch controls increase from 20px (Set up where alerts go) and 34px (Turn on delivery) to 44px/44px with decorative icon aria-hidden=true.

/alerts active delivery with zero enabled destinations (AlertNoDestinationsCard): desktop preserves compact 32px/34px layout; phone touch controls increase from 32px (Manage destinations) and 34px (Dismiss) to 44px/44px with decorative icon aria-hidden=true.

/alerts/notifications destination config load failure (AlertDestinationsLoadErrorCard): card exposes role=alert (previously missing), Retry declares type=button (previously missing), icon top-aligns cleanly with multi-line phone error text with aria-hidden=true, and phone Retry control increases from 34px to 44px.
interactions: Clicked Turn on delivery in AlertDeliveryPausedCard on /alerts in both desktop Chromium and phone WebKit; verified POST /api/alerts/activate succeeded.
Clicked Dismiss in AlertNoDestinationsCard on /alerts in both desktop Chromium and phone WebKit; verified banner dismissed cleanly.

Clicked Retry in AlertDestinationsLoadErrorCard on /alerts/notifications after simulated HTTP 503 on GET /api/notifications/webhooks in both desktop Chromium and phone WebKit; verified fresh GET /api/notifications/webhooks succeeded and the error banner cleared.
